evidence.summary: CLI prints a valid X.Y.Z or an incremented X.Y.Z. Invalid input exits nonzero with empty stdout. This slice covers one version and major, minor or patch.

features.name: Echo one valid version
features.behavior: Prints the version and exits 0. Leading zeros are invalid.

features.name: Increment major, minor or patch
features.behavior: Prints the incremented version and exits 0. --inc is the long flag.

features.name: Reject invalid versions
features.behavior: Exits nonzero and prints nothing for a non-version, a partial version, or a leading zero.
